production_owners.rule: Guest observation is a narrow test seam on the actual runtime. Failed fixture gate locking remains a typed Incomplete error.
Remove the old AnalysisPackageOwner mutation wrapper. Runtime owns optional shared fixture code; evaluation stores and counters remain separate.

Retain exactly five compiled fixture sources, measured cache charges, resource-option separation, fresh stores/counters, and shared executable pins. Configured compiler_bytes is explicitly Unsupported.
Keep Discovery, Process, Credentials, Kubernetes, and Runtime component bytes. No production fixture factory is added.

Open the existing authority watch before the operation. Bind current grant expiry, cancel the operation scope on change, and join native workers before a denial result. Remove the per-operation OS thread and private Tokio runtime.

Actual native workers own their controls and leases through completion. Explicit cancellation joins them. Dropped work cancels its child scope; the caller control remains usable. No claim is made about an executor that stops polling or an abrupt runtime shutdown.
